caption: Erechtheion, Athens
composition: Ionic Erechtheion with the Caryatid porch, Parthenon beyond · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the east side of the Erechtheion, looking west, the south porch of six Caryatids is on the left and the tall Ionic columns of the north porch are on the right. The roofless Parthenon sits farther left on the same Acropolis rock. Warm-white architectural light is on the marble under a clear sky, about 12.2°C. No published shutoff was found for the standing Acropolis illumination before dawn, so those lights are depicted; this is not an on-site check that they were burning at 05:53.
